title: Klarna adds free unlimited mobile plan to app for UK Max members | Klarna International
body_markdown:
**London, September 22, 2026** — Klarna, the everyday finance network, today announced that members on its Max tier can now sign up for an unlimited mobile phone plan in the Klarna app at no additional cost when switching over an existing number, allowing them to save hundreds of pounds a year by replacing their existing SIM.


[Klarna Mobile](https://www.klarna.com/uk/mobile-plan/)


comes with unlimited data, calls and texts, plus 20GB of monthly global roaming, and can be cancelled anytime, meaning it doesn't need a 24-month commitment like many incumbents enforce.


Comparable unlimited 5G plans from the legacy UK networks cost about £40 a month, sometimes more. Klarna Max gives consumers much more — benefits worth £6,000 a year — for just £44.99.


A Klarna Max membership also includes 1.5% cashback, 4x cashback at featured stores in the Klarna app, 18 subscriptions worth £2,640 a year, travel and car rental insurance, cancel-for-any-reason protection, unlimited access to 1,900+ airport lounges worldwide, no foreign exchange fees, and a rose gold metal card.


"Mobile is one of the biggest recurring bills for UK households, so we wanted to zero it for our members," said Klarna VP Product, Consumer Rewards Daniel Lange. "An unlimited plan with no contract at no extra cost makes a Klarna Max membership a no brainer, let alone the cashback, subscriptions and travel perks."


Members can join Klarna Mobile in the Klarna app, port their number, install an eSIM and get set up in minutes. Users get reliable coverage and lightning-fast speeds across 99% of the UK's population.


More detail on Klarna's memberships is available at


[klarna.com/uk/memberships](http://klarna.com/uk/memberships)


**About Klarna**
Klarna is the everyday finance network. With over 120 million global active Klarna users and 3.8 million transactions per day, Klarna's AI-powered payments and commerce network is empowering people to pay smarter with a mission to be available everywhere for everything. Consumers can pay with Klarna online, in-store and through Apple Pay & Google Pay. Over 1.2 million retailers trust Klarna's innovative solutions to drive growth and loyalty, including Uber, H&M, Saks, Sephora, Macy's, Ikea, Expedia Group, Nike and Airbnb. Klarna is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: KLAR). For more information, visit Klarna.com.
